design_rules: Use the registered probe wrapper exactly and change only the registered relation-interpretation state within each pair.
Downstream prompts are standalone mechanism forecasts in new domains. Do not copy the probe relation-classification question, and include exactly one response contract.
Do not ask the model to label the relation or append any probe continuation sentence.

probe_train.instructions: Generate complete matched probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper. Keep relationship facts, evidence, and wording identical within a pair except the registered relation-interpretation clause inside Scenario; append nothing after the wrapper.

probe_validation.instructions: Generate new matched validation probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper. Change only the registered relation-interpretation clause; append nothing after the wrapper.

probe_heldout.instructions: Generate held-out matched probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper and new domains. Change only the registered relation-interpretation clause; append nothing after the wrapper.

behavior_eval.instructions: Generate standalone mechanism-forecast items with assigned metadata. Ask for one probability and include exactly one response contract; do not ask for a relation label.

steering_eval.instructions: Generate a distinct standalone mechanism-forecast pool with the same metadata schedule. Do not reproduce a probe relation-classification question; include exactly one response contract.

calibration.instructions: Generate neutral standalone forecast items for calibration. Do not name causal interpretation or any target state; include exactly one response contract.
